---
name: curation-entry
description: Add a learn-by-building project to Ventura Build with target skill deliverable and verification path defined. Use when extending the repository's project-based learning catalog. Do not use when changing the shared repository CI workflow or implementing the project in another repository.
---

# Curation entry

- Read the existing project-learning structure before adding an entry.
- Define the skill to practice and the artifact the learner should build.
- Include a concrete verification step rather than completion by reading alone.
- Keep prerequisites and scope small enough for the intended level.
- Link canonical references only when they are necessary to complete the build.
- Avoid duplicate projects that exercise the same outcome without a meaningful new constraint.
